case_name: Joseph Donald Thornblad v. Larry Olson, M.D., Medical Director of Willmar Regional Treatment Center

headnotes.text: Where procedural bar, exhaustion and mootness questions in a habeas case are complicated and doubtful but the merits are simple and plain, a federal court may assume the petitioner is entitled to review and reject the claims on the merits.
